hypotheses_proposed_not_results.statement: On frozen unseen semantic groups, the existing semantic-plus-numeric acceptance rule lowers accepted contract errors relative to numeric verification alone while retaining at least 80% of the latter arm’s correctly accepted supported cases.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.falsification: Either the paired accepted-error count is not lower or correct-answer retention is below 0.80; report an inconclusive finite result separately from population claims.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.design: Same actual model proposals, immutable inputs, independent gold; no rewriting verifier after inspecting test outputs.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.limits: Potentially useful finite evidence, not novel selective prediction theory; use per-group paired outcomes.

hypotheses_proposed_not_results.statement: Documentation-backed SDK/device checks reject constructible but unsupported quantum programs that pass abstract mathematical validation, with no loss on a separately established valid control set.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.falsification: No additional inadmissible case detected, or valid controls incorrectly rejected.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.design: Disjoint cases with explicit source-bound device specs; distinguish model equivalence, SDK acceptance, documented compatibility and QPU execution.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.limits: SDK/device checks establish only their documented abstraction; no QPU permitted.

hypotheses_proposed_not_results.statement: A frozen clause-grounded semantic verifier retains at least 80% of its development correct-acceptance rate under new genres and language paraphrases while reducing paired error acceptance relative to a keyword rule.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.falsification: Held-out retention below 0.80 or no paired error reduction; analyze by family and genre.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.design: Reserve entire base-intention groups and paraphrase genres; two families share error types; no label access by evaluated agent.
hypotheses_proposed_not_results.limits: Threshold is proposed before C11, not a source-derived guarantee; new family generalization requires an actual additional family.

originality_assessment: No novelty established. Semantic verification, intermodule consistency, abstention and quantum orchestration already have close primary precedents. A possible contribution is a carefully bounded, independently annotated cross-domain experiment connecting semantic acceptance to source-scoped software/device constraints.
metric_warning: VeriSimpl coverage uses verified/correctly answered, whereas selective coverage uses accepted/all. Do not compare these denominators directly.
